name: member_savings_balance
description: Looks up a credit union or bank member by their member ID and retrieves their current savings account balance. This capability requires authentication credentials to access the member management system. It navigates to the member lookup interface, searches for the specified member ID, accesses the member's detail page, and extracts the savings balance value. Returns the savings balance as a string formatted with currency notation.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the member whose savings balance should be retrieved (e.g., '12345')

parameters.name: operator_user
parameters.description: operator_user (secret; supplied at invocation, never stored)

parameters.name: operator_password
parameters.description: operator_password (secret; supplied at invocation, never stored)

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: The current savings account balance for the member, formatted as a currency string (e.g., '4,812.37')
